title: Page 4
content_zh:
“那有什么问题，走吧。”左语恩勾住她的手。“看你要吃多大餐就吃多大的餐，包准撑死你……”

两个女人说说笑笑地往停车场走去。

席舞笑着，却是心不在焉，想到方才那个吻，想到齐藤英树问她那句饶富深意的话，还有盯着她看的眼神……

该不会，他其实已经认出她来？

认出她来却又这样轻易让她离开，是不是就表示他其实并不想揭露这一切？因为他也认为，两人各过各的比较好？过去的就让它过去？

因为他根本从没爱过她……

“他们会结婚吧？语恩？”席舞突然问。

左语恩开着车，愣了一下才反应过来，她问的是齐藤英树和凯基电通的蓝琳两个人，若有所思地看了她一眼。“你希望他们不结婚？”

席舞闻言瞪大了眼，一副见鬼的表情。“我为什么要不希望？他们很登对啊，正常的有钱人要娶的老婆，不就该是一样的有钱千金吗？像蓝琳这样的才适合他，又美又高贵又温柔体贴……”

“怪了，我怎么好像闻到了醋味？”左语恩好笑地打趣道：“依我看，他对你挺有兴趣的，要不把他抢过来？”

“胡说八道什么呢！”席舞心虚地看向窗外。“他那种高高在上的人怎么会对我这种平凡女子有兴趣？你鼻子有问题，我吃啥醋了？”

“那请问一下，像他这样高高在上的男人为什么突然说要绑架你？你跟他有仇？欠他钱？还是欠他情？”

犀利啊……

果真是干记者的，什么都灵光啊……

“我们一定要谈论这个问题吗？”

“你或许可以先回答我一个问题——你以前就认识他了吧？你借我的眼镜就是为了躲他？”

席舞叹了口气。“嗯。”

“那他跟黑道有没有关系？”

席舞没好气地瞪着开车的女人。“左语恩小姐，你这已经是第二个问题了，你到底是不是真心想请我吃大餐啊？还是根本是来挖新闻的？”

左语恩伸手推推脸上的黑框眼镜，很温柔地笑着。“顺便嘛，搞不好杂志社下一期的主题可以变成黑道企业大哥的秘密情人之类的？”

唉。“停车！”

左语恩撒娇地睨了她一眼。“干么？不是要吃大餐？”

“不吃了！跟你吃饭我的胃口一定不好，搞不好吃多了回去还必须吃胃药——”

“好了好了，不问你就是了，想吃什么？日本料理？”

席舞皮笑肉不笑地看她一眼。“我最讨厌吃的就是日本料理了，你不知道吗？”

“这不会也跟齐藤先生有关？”

“喂——”

左语恩镜片下的眼又是闪闪笑意。“好好好，不说他，那说一下你最近休假都在干什么吧？”

“我啊，跑夜店啊、舞厅啊。”

“你？”左语恩一脸的疑问。“年轻时没玩到？补玩？”

“高档的那种，富商俱乐部之类的。”

“兼差？”左语恩开玩笑地问。

“是啊。”席舞很正经地答。

“喂，真的假的？”

“当然是真的啊。”席舞很无奈地耸肩，可怜兮兮地看着她。“你知道的，台北生活大不易啊，人总要为五斗米折腰啊。”

“席舞……”左语恩的表情有点凝重。“你缺钱吗？如果不多，我可以先借你，真的。”

“真的？可以借多少？”席舞的眼眸闪闪发亮。“一百万还是两百万？”

嗄？要借这么多？

左语恩咬住唇，一脸为难。“要不，我帮你去跟黑少借？”

“黑少啊……”席舞更加的一脸哀怨。“就是他把我推进火坑的……”

“什么？”左语恩惊叫出声，一个没注意，车子差点撞上路边的电线杆，瞬间煞车声和尖叫声连连。

席舞的头撞到前方玻璃，痛得她哀叫。“左语恩，你有没有那么夸张啊？是不是只要听到黑少两个字你就很激动？”

“我、哪有……你别胡说！只是没想到黑少会是这样的人……”左语恩激动得几乎说不出话来。

席舞痛得揉揉额头。“他本来就是个为达目的，不惜让员工出生入死的老板啊，有需要这么激动吗？”

“那也不可以叫你去那种地方兼差当小姐啊！”

席舞看左语恩气得一脸苍白，知道自己玩笑开得有点过火了，忙伸手推了推她。“你别紧张啦，他是要我混进里头偷拍一些照片回来，你也知道，那种地方政商名流多，新闻秘辛更多，最近要选举了，总有一些八卦照片可以拍，只是这样而已，再也没有其他了。”

左语恩看她一眼。“真的？”

“当然。”

“那他可以叫男的去啊，你一个人混进去多危险！”

“不会啦，你别担心，我是混进去玩的，顺便偷拍照片，况且我是客人，谁敢对我怎么样？女人总是方便些嘛。不然叫小波去？拍回来的照片应该都是波霸吧？”说着，席舞看了左语恩一眼。“对吧？小波那么爱波霸，嗯？”

两人你看我我看你好一会儿，蓦地大笑出声。

是啊，小波爱波霸，所以才被叫成小波啊！

这天，如果席舞知道后来会遇见什么，她应该就不会鸡婆地帮老板黑少说话了，因为他推她进的这个坑，可比她想像中的大了……

席舞真的不知道发生了什么事，她只是回来俱乐部拿二十分钟前遗落在这间包厢里的相机而已。

这间包厢很隐密，位在俱乐部的最角落，窗外绿树成荫，透过树间望出去是俱乐部的游泳池之一，当时她正启动录影功能，想偷偷把游泳池那边的影像给录下来。

要不是手机突然响起，她不会把正在录影中的相机在窗台上随手一搁；要不是这包厢，的收讯功能不大好，她也不会跑出去接听完电话就往外走，而忘了回来拿放在这里的相机……

她根本是一路飞奔回来的！当她想到她可爱的相机有可能在服务生进来收拾之前不见或被偷，她就紧张到心臓快停了！

那相机要价不菲，可是她的命根子之一啊，所以，当她冲进来看见它依然好好地被搁在角落高高的窗台上时，当真觉得幸运不已。

但她真的高兴得太早了，她走出包厢低头把相机的录影功能关上，才要把它挂上脖子，突然有人叫住了她，她回过头去，看见几个穿西装的男人正神色不善地看着她，还有她手上的相机。

“你是从这间包厢走出来的？”站中间的男人问。

“是，我回来拿我的相机……有问题吗？”

“相机交出来。”男人朝她伸出手。

那手，沾染上一抹红，那红很鲜，沿着他的手往上看去，她甚至看见了那男人的白色衬衫也沾了一抹红……

不只他，还有他身旁的人也是，衣裤上多多少少都沾到了那令人触目惊心的红，一阵风吹来，她甚至闻到一股腥味……

这味道，她再熟悉不过。

九年前，她曾数次在这种味道中醒来又昏迷，离死亡的边缘好近好近，近到她连沐浴在其中都无力尖叫恶心的地步。

是血的味道。

席舞下意识退了一步，用手护住相机。“这个不能给你们！”

先不说这相机是她的宝贝，就算不是，她之前拍下一堆达官贵人的照片在里头，这一交出去还得了？任务没办成就算了，她可能还会被告去吃牢饭！

“你不要敬酒不吃吃罚酒！”

“几位大哥，这相机是我的，你们为什么要拿我的相机？”席舞边说边往后又退一步。

“交过来就是了，废话这么多？”带头的男人有点不耐烦。
content_en:
"What's the problem? Let's go." Zuo Yuen took her hand."It depends on how big of a meal you want. I'll definitely eat you to death..."

The two women walked to the parking lot talking and laughing.

Xi Wu smiled, but absent-mindedly, thinking of the kiss just now, the meaningful words Saito Hideki asked her, and the eyes staring at her...

Could it be that he has actually recognized her?

Does recognizing her but letting her leave so easily mean that he doesn't actually want to reveal all this?Because he also believes that it is better for the two of them to live their own lives?Just let the past go?

Because he never loved her at all...

"Will they get married? Yu En?" Xi Wu suddenly asked.

Zuo Yuen drove the car and was stunned for a moment before realizing that she was asking about Hideki Saito and Lan Lin from Kaiji Dentsu, and he looked at her thoughtfully."You hope they don't get married?"

Xi Wu's eyes widened when he heard this, as if he had seen a ghost."Why shouldn't I hope? They are so right. A normal rich man's wife should be a wealthy woman, right? Someone like Lan Lin is suitable for him. She is beautiful, noble, gentle and considerate..."

"It's weird, why do I seem to smell vinegar?" Zuo Yuen joked funnyly: "In my opinion, he is quite interested in you, why don't you snatch him over?"

"What nonsense are you talking about!" Xi Wu looked out the window guiltily."How could someone like him be interested in an ordinary woman like me? You have a problem with your nose. Why am I jealous?"

"Then let me ask you, why does a man as high and mighty as him suddenly say he wants to kidnap you? Do you have a grudge against him? Do you owe him money? Or do you owe him a favor?"

Sharp...

If you are really a reporter, you have a good idea of everything...

"Do we have to talk about this?"

"Perhaps you can answer me a question first - you have known him before, right? Are you borrowing my glasses just to avoid him?"

Xi Wu sighed."Yeah."

"Then does he have anything to do with the underworld?"

Xi Wu glared at the woman driving the car angrily."Miss Zuo Yuen, this is already your second question. Do you really want to treat me to a big dinner? Or are you just here to dig up news?"

Zuo Yuen stretched out his hand to push up the black-rimmed glasses on his face, smiling softly."By the way, maybe the theme of the next issue of the magazine can be the secret lover of the underworld corporate boss?"

Alas."Stop!"

Zuo Yuen glanced at her coquettishly."What for? Don't you want a big meal?"

"I won't eat! My appetite must be bad if I eat with you. Maybe if I eat too much, I will have to take stomach medicine when I go back——"

"Okay, okay, I won't ask you. What do you want to eat? Japanese food?"

Xi Wupi looked at her with a smile."What I hate eating the most is Japanese food, don't you know?"

"Could this also be related to Mr. Saito?"

"Hey——"

Zuo Yuen's eyes under the lenses were shining with a smile again."Okay, okay, if you don't want to talk about him, then tell me what you have been doing during your recent vacation, right?"

"I go to nightclubs and dance clubs."

"You?" Zuo Yuen looked questioning."Didn't you play it when you were young? Playing it again?"

"A high-end one, like a wealthy businessman's club."

"Part-time job?" Zuo Yuen asked jokingly.

"Yes." Xi Wu replied seriously.

"Hey, is it true?"

"Of course it's true." Xi Wu shrugged helplessly and looked at her pitifully."You know, life in Taipei is not easy. People always have to sacrifice themselves for five buckets of rice."

"Xi Wu..." Zuo Yuen's expression was a little solemn."Are you short of money? If it's not much, I can lend you money first, really."

"Really? How much can I borrow?" Xi Wu's eyes sparkled."One million or two million?"

Huh?Want to borrow so much?

Zuo Yuen bit her lip, looking embarrassed."How about I help you borrow it from Mr. Hei?"

"Young Master Hei..." Xi Wu looked even more sad."He was the one who pushed me into the fire pit..."

"What?" Zuo Yuen screamed. Without paying attention, the car almost hit a telephone pole on the side of the road, and instantly there were sounds of brakes and screams.

Xi Wu's head hit the front glass, causing her to cry out in pain."Zuo Yu'en, are you that exaggerated? Are you excited just by hearing the word Hei Shao?"

"I, there is no way...don't talk nonsense! I just didn't expect that Young Master Hei would be such a person..." Zuo Yuen was so excited that he could hardly speak.

Xi Wu rubbed his forehead in pain."He is a boss who is willing to put his employees through life and death in order to achieve his goals. Do you need to be so excited?"

"Then I can't ask you to work part-time as a young lady in a place like that!"

Seeing Zuo Yuen's face pale with anger, Xi Wu knew that her joke had gone too far, so she hurriedly stretched out her hand to push her."Don't be nervous, he wants me to sneak in and secretly take some photos. As you know, there are many political and business celebrities in that kind of place, and there are more news secrets. There is an election soon, and there are always some gossip photos to take. That's it, nothing else."

Zuo Yuen glanced at her."Really?"

"Of course."

"Then he can ask a man to go there. How dangerous it would be for you to sneak in alone!"

"No, don't worry. I just sneaked in and took photos secretly. Besides, I'm a guest. Who dares to do anything to me? Women are always more convenient. Otherwise, let Xiaobo go? The photos taken should be all Boba, right?" As he said that, Xi Wu glanced at Zuo Yuen."Right? Xiaobo loves Boba so much, huh?"

The two of them looked at each other for a while, then burst into laughter.

Yes, Xiaobo loves Bobo, that’s why he is called Xiaobo!

On this day, if Xi Wu had known what she would encounter later, she probably wouldn't have helped her boss Hei Shao so stupidly, because the pit he pushed her into was bigger than she imagined...

Xi Wu really didn't know what happened. She just came back to the club to get the camera she left in this box twenty minutes ago.

This box was very private, located in the very corner of the club. The window was lined with green trees. Through the trees, she could see one of the club's swimming pools. At that time, she was activating the video recording function and wanted to secretly record the images from the swimming pool.

If her cell phone hadn't rang suddenly, she wouldn't have put the camera that was recording on the window sill. If it weren't for the reception function of this private room, she wouldn't have run out after answering the phone and walked out, forgetting to come back to pick up the camera...

She basically ran all the way back!When she thought about the possibility that her lovely camera might be missing or stolen before the waiter came in to clean it up, she was so nervous that her heart almost stopped!

The camera cost a lot of money, but it was one of her lifeblood, so when she rushed in and saw that it was still well placed on the high windowsill in the corner, she felt really lucky.

But she was really happy too early. She walked out of the box and lowered her head to turn off the recording function of the camera before hanging it around her neck. Suddenly someone called her. She turned around and saw several men in suits looking at her with unkind expressions, as well as the camera in her hand.

"Did you come out of this box?" the man standing in the middle asked.

"Yes, I'll come back to get my camera...any questions?"

"Hand over the camera." The man stretched out his hand towards her.

That hand was stained with a touch of red. The red was very bright. Looking up along his hand, she even saw that the man's white shirt was also stained with a touch of red...

Not only him, but also the people around him, their clothes and pants were all stained with that shocking red color. A gust of wind blew, and she even smelled a fishy smell...

This smell was all too familiar to her.

Nine years ago, she woke up and fell into coma several times due to this smell. She was so close to the edge of death, so close that she couldn't even scream in disgust even while bathing in it.

It's the smell of blood.

Xi Wu subconsciously took a step back and protected the camera with her hands."I can't give you this!"

Not to mention that this camera is her treasure. Even if it is not, she has taken a bunch of photos of dignitaries in it. Is it okay to hand it over now?If the task is not completed, then forget it, she may even be accused of going to jail!

"Don't toast me and you'll be fined if you don't eat!"

"Brothers, this camera belongs to me, why do you want to take my camera?" Xi Wu said as he took a step back.

"Just hand it over, is there so much nonsense?" The man in the lead was a little impatient.
